sentences.text: Lajina Khatun @ Lazina Khatun vs Unknown on 12 September,

2024 
Author: Soumen Sen
Bench: Soumen Sen
12.09.2024
 Sl No.46
Court No.29
 (gc)
(Rejected)
 Crm (A) 3279 of 2024
 In Re:- An application for anticipatory bail under Section 438 of
 the Code of Criminal Procedure corresponding to Section 482 of
 the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 filed in
 connection with Beldanga Police Station Case No.289 of 2023
 dated 19.04.2023 under Sections 498A/325/307/34 of the
 Indian Penal Code and charge sheet submitted under Section
 498A/325/307/34 of the Ipc and adding Section 302 of the Ipc.
 And

In the matter of : Lajina Khatun @ Lazina Khatun
 - Petitioner.

Ms. Shabana Hasin,
 Ms. Samima Akter

Ms. Sayanti Santra,
 Mr. Soumyadip Saha

1.
Heard the learned Counsel for the parties.

2. Considering the statement of the eyewitness recorded under Section 164 of the Cr.P.C. directly implicating the petitioner of physical torture which has resulted in an unnatural death of the victim and having regard to the remarks in the postmortem report that there has been injury on the left cheek to left face and right shoulder, we are not inclined to grant anticipatory bail to the petitioner.
3. Accordingly, the application for anticipatory bail is rejected.
4. All parties shall act on the server copy of this order duly downloaded from the official website of this Court.
